hypothesis: Original one-word feature is static; exact official previous-session proxy identity and its transition to current turnover may recover promotion recall without broad class balancing. The old proxy remains distinct from verified OHLC identity; theme support is separate and does not enter this challenge.
definition: Previous row is same code on exact official predecessor session, all original candidates retained; previous boards+1=current boards, previous/current signal_one_word each 0/1. Prior identity = original previous signal_one_word; transition=(1-current)*prior; missing previous row, unknown proxy or inconsistent board relation stays NaN. Never use target-day OHLC, target label or last observed older appearance.
sample_weights: Original inverse labeled-candidate count per signal date, unchanged.
preprocessing: Original median/add_indicator/keep_empty_features/scaler; fit on same original training members only.
future_acceptance: Past labels were previously seen; any surviving challenge needs a separate future fixed 120-official-day protocol and full original stock acceptance gates. No retroactive Oct8 new forecast; no automatic upgrade.
stopping: Three predetermined folds, each fit once. No threshold/parameter search, no alternative fit on failure; stop after fixed comparison or 30 minutes.
